UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents the customer's primary profile, avatar, role, legal account type, subscription tier, notification preferences, and current wallet balance.

userId.description: Unique Firebase Auth UID of the user.

fullName.description: Full Arabic name of the user.

avatarUrl.description: Uploaded profile avatar URL or data URI.

accountType.description: Legal status: Individual (فرد) or Family Record Keeper (أمين السجل).

originRegion.description: Region or city of ancestral origin.

subscriptionTier.description: Current subscription tier: Free, Basic ($5 verified root), or Premium Annual ($60/yr).

walletBalance.description: Available wallet credit balance in USD.

isRootUnlocked.description: Whether the $5 connection root is unlocked.

emailNotificationsEnabled.description: Whether email notifications for research tickets and family tree updates are enabled.

paidRevenueUsd.description: Total revenue paid by the user in USD.

unlockedCapsules.description: IDs of unlocked intermediate ancestor capsules.

bridgedAncestors.description: Custom bridged ancestors added by the customer between family and root.

unlockedAddonSourceIds.description: Unlocked verified addon historical source IDs.

emailNotificationsTicket.description: Whether ticket update email notifications are enabled.

emailNotificationsTree.description: Whether family tree & vault email notifications are enabled.

agreedToTermsAndPrivacy.description: Whether the user agreed to Terms of Use and Privacy Policy upon registration.

termsAndPrivacyAgreedAt.description: ISO timestamp when Terms of Use and Privacy Policy were accepted.

termsAndPrivacyVersion.description: Version of Terms of Use and Privacy Policy accepted.

termsIpAddress.description: Client IP address captured when Terms & Privacy were accepted.

recordKeeperCharterSigned.description: Whether the Record Keeper Service Contract was electronically signed.

recordKeeperCharterSignedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the Record Keeper Service Contract was signed.

recordKeeperCharterCode.description: Unique Certificate of Completion / Charter ID.

recordKeeperContractVersion.description: Signed Record Keeper contract version (e.g. V2_24 May_2026).

disambiguationChoiceId.description: Selected geographic or branch disambiguation choice ID from the initial lineage search.

verifiedLineageSnapshot.description: Structured native map snapshot of the customer's verified lineage search result for instant rendering in CustomerDashboard.

lineageSnapshot.description: Structured native map alias of the customer's lineage snapshot.

emailVerified.description: Whether the customer's email address has been verified via Google OAuth or 6-digit OTP.

emailVerifiedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the customer's email address was verified.

publishedSiteSlug.description: Primary active family microsite slug owned by this Record Keeper.

ownedSiteSlugs.description: All unique family microsite slugs owned and managed by this Record Keeper.

referralCode.description: Deterministic referral code (JTH-XXXXX) for the $10 atomic referral engine.

referredByUserId.description: UID of the inviter who referred this customer.

referralRewardClaimed.description: Idempotency flag ensuring the $10 referral reward is paid at most once on first annual subscription.

lastWalletTransactionId.description: ID of the atomic wallet_transactions ledger entry paired with the latest walletBalance or tier mutation.

LegalAuditTrailEntry.title: LegalAuditTrailEntry
LegalAuditTrailEntry.description: Immutable electronic signature, Terms/Privacy consent, and Certificate of Completion audit trail entry linked to a specific user.

userFullName.description: Full name of the signing user.

familyName.description: Family name associated with the record.

userEmail.description: Registered email of the signing user.

eventType.description: Type of legal consent or contract execution.

documentTitle.description: Title of the signed contract or policy.

certificateCode.description: Certificate of Completion / Audit reference code.

orderReference.description: Associated order or account reference ID.

consentStatement.description: Exact legal consent text accepted by the user.

ipAddress.description: Client IP address at time of consent.

ipCountry.description: Client country at time of consent.

ipCity.description: Client city at time of consent.

userAgent.description: Browser and OS user agent string.

verificationMethod.description: Authentication/verification method used (e.g. Email + Password / Google OAuth / Session Auth).

status.description: Completion status of the electronic record.

FamilyTreeDocument.title: FamilyTreeDocument
FamilyTreeDocument.description: Stores the interactive family tree nodes (شجرتي), vault archive (خزانتي), and workspace preferences for a customer.

peopleJson.description: Serialized interactive tree nodes, vault archive, or workspace state.

CustomerOrder.title: CustomerOrder
CustomerOrder.description: Represents a real customer lineage search & subscription order visible in the /Team Operations Hub.

ResearchTicket.title: ResearchTicket
ResearchTicket.description: Genealogical investigation or enrichment ticket stored in Firebase and processed in Researcher Studio.

userId.description: UID of the user who owns this search ticket.

familyName.description: Family or clan surname of the customer.

targetAncestor.description: Target lineage chain supplied by customer.

verificationChoiceLabel.description: Summary of the reason or verification path selected for the ticket.

additionalNotes.description: Family oral history notes or corroborating evidence summary.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of genealogical research.

assignedResearcherId.description: UID of the genealogical researcher assigned to the case.

researchFindings.description: Genealogist's findings and verified lineage chain.

attachments.description: Supporting documents attached from Family Vault or smart media pipeline.

messages.description: Interactive clarification messages between customer and researcher.

resolutionPayload.description: Structured verified lineage decision ready for 1-click customer adoption into Spine and Tree.

clientNotified.description: Whether notification has been dispatched to the client.

priorityTag.description: Priority classification tag such as PRIORITY_REGISTRAR for Family Record Keepers.

ResearchTicketMessage.title: ResearchTicketMessage
ResearchTicketMessage.description: Interactive message or clarification attachment inside a research ticket thread.

PublicMicrosite.title: PublicMicrosite
PublicMicrosite.description: Filtered Mirror family microsite (commercial upper lineage and certified reference nodes strictly stripped) with 5 scoped heritage themes, dual privacy matrix, 4 female policies, and 12 agile CMS modules.

KinshipCircle.title: KinshipCircle
KinshipCircle.description: Private kinship circle managed by the Family Record Keeper with authorized relatives and opt-out tokens.

KinshipInvitation.title: KinshipInvitation
KinshipInvitation.description: Capability-token kinship invitation record enabling zero-friction relative onboarding, 1-click unauthenticated opt-out, referral attribution, and active status tracking.

inviteToken.description: High-entropy capability token embedded in invitation and opt-out URLs.

EnrichmentRequest.title: EnrichmentRequest
EnrichmentRequest.description: Closed-loop family enrichment submission from a family microsite visitor/relative into the Record Keeper's inbox.

PublicSiteDirectoryHeader.title: PublicSiteDirectoryHeader
PublicSiteDirectoryHeader.description: Zero-PII slug existence and access-mode header enabling PRIVATE_WHITELIST portals to display an access request gate without exposing private site data.

SiteAccessRequest.title: SiteAccessRequest
SiteAccessRequest.description: Access request submitted on a PRIVATE_WHITELIST family microsite for Record Keeper approval.

SiteGuestbookEntry.title: SiteGuestbookEntry
SiteGuestbookEntry.description: Moderated guestbook entry for a family microsite (published only after Record Keeper approval).

ReferralCodeIndex.title: ReferralCodeIndex
ReferralCodeIndex.description: Lookup index mapping a deterministic referral code (JTH-XXXXX) to its owner UID and invitee ledger.

WalletTransaction.title: WalletTransaction
WalletTransaction.description: Atomic financial ledger entry for customer wallet top-ups, $5 root purchases, capsule unlocks, package/registrar upgrades, and $10 referral rewards.

paymentMethod.description: Whether settled by internal wallet deduction or external card/Mada/ApplePay gateway.

bonusCreditUsd.description: Optional promotional wallet credit granted alongside an annual subscription upgrade.

balanceBefore.description: Customer wallet balance immediately before this transaction.

balanceAfter.description: Customer wallet balance immediately after this transaction.

status.description: Execution status of the financial transaction.

descriptionAr.description: Clear Arabic description of the financial transaction.

referenceId.description: Associated order or feature reference ID.

referredInviteeUid.description: UID of the upgrading invitee who triggered the atomic $10 referral reward.

CustomerNotification.title: CustomerNotification
CustomerNotification.description: Proactive customer support message, feature announcement, or ticket status update sent to a user.

actionUrl.description: Optional in-app route or action identifier.

TeamMember.title: TeamMember
TeamMember.description: Isolated /Team staff and admin member record with strict RBAC roles.

canonicalMemberId.description: Canonical /team_members/{id} reference for Firebase Auth UID binding records.

isAuthUidBinding.description: True when document maps a staff Firebase Auth UID to their canonical team_members record.

KnowledgeArticle.title: KnowledgeArticle
KnowledgeArticle.description: Article or video published in the Juthori Knowledge Center (المركز المعرفي).

content.description: Full rich HTML article content including inline images.

coverTextOverlay.description: Text overlay displayed on the cover image.

coverImageUrl.description: Cover image URL or standardized 16:9 data URL.

videoUrl.description: Video URL if type is video.

KashafiItem.title: KashafiItem
KashafiItem.description: Real client-specific scientific discovery, automatic research ticket milestone, or delivered Kashafi report shown in the customer Kashafi radar.

KashafiCampaign.title: KashafiCampaign
KashafiCampaign.description: Admin-published Kashafi research service, digital upgrade, or platform announcement targeted to eligible client segments.

KashafiServiceOrder.title: KashafiServiceOrder
KashafiServiceOrder.description: Customer order for a Kashafi research execution service, auto-assigned to the Research Manager inbox.

/users/{userId}/wallet_transactions/{txI.description: Subcollection recording financial credit and debit transactions.

/users/{userId}/family_tree/{treeId}.description: Subcollection storing interactive family tree data (شجرتي).

/users/{userId}/audit_trail/{auditId}.description: Subcollection storing electronic signature, Terms/Privacy consent, and Certificate of Completion audit records for the user.

/audit_trail/{auditId}.description: Centralized audit trail collection of all user electronic signatures and legal consents.

/wallet_transactions/{txId}.description: Centralized structured financial ledger of all customer wallet top-ups, root unlocks, capsule purchases, and membership upgrades.

/customer_orders/{orderId}.description: Real customer orders and lineage search records managed in /Team.

/research_tickets/{ticketId}/messages/{m.description: Interactive message thread inside a research ticket.

/public_sites/{siteSlug}.description: Filtered Mirror family microsites strictly isolated from private lineage and reference sources.

/public_sites/{siteSlug}/passcode_mirror.description: Sanitized capability-keyed microsite mirror unlocked exclusively with the exact SHA-256 hash of the family passcode (list disabled, PII stripped).

/public_site_directory/{siteSlug}.description: Zero-PII slug existence and access-mode directory header for PRIVATE_WHITELIST portals.

/kinship_circles/{ownerId}.description: Private kinship circle of authorized family relatives managed by the Record Keeper.

/kinship_invitations/{inviteToken}.description: Capability-token kinship invitations for VIP landing onboarding and 1-click privacy opt-out.

/enrichment_requests/{requestId}.description: Closed-loop enrichment requests submitted from family microsites into the Record Keeper's inbox.

/tree_enrichment_requests/{requestId}.description: Mirrored enrichment requests collection path guarded identically for Record Keeper review.

/site_access_requests/{requestId}.description: Access requests for PRIVATE_WHITELIST family microsites.

/site_guestbook/{entryId}.description: Moderated guestbook entries for family microsites.

/referral_codes/{code}.description: Deterministic referral code registry for the atomic $10 referral reward engine.

/knowledge_articles/{articleId}.description: Articles and studies for the Knowledge Center.

/kashafi_items/{itemId}.description: Real client-targeted scientific discoveries, automatic ticket milestones, and delivered Kashafi reports.

/kashafi_campaigns/{campaignId}.description: Admin-published Kashafi services, digital features, and platform announcements.

/kashafi_service_orders/{orderId}.description: Customer Kashafi research service orders auto-assigned to the Research Manager inbox.
